name: UCSB November Weekday 2026
information:
# This is a weeknight competiton!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSBNovemberWeekday2026#82246-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
​
Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.
​
This competition is organized by UCSB Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/).
​

### UCSB Students
If you are a UCSB Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCSBNovemberWeekday2026&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
